name: Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia Concerto 2
original_name: 光翼戦姫エクスティアコンチェルト2
source:
For the sake of another, I fight

Scattered across the peaceful city of Kawado Higashi are "Guilt Seeds" that cause people's desires to run wild, turning them into dangerous monsters.

To prevent the inevitable disaster that would occur if left unchecked, Ichika Itakano charges Haruno Aikawa with the collection of these seeds. With her newly acquired ExS-Device, Haruno is able to transform into ExS-TIA Ignis and search for the Guilt Seeds.

At the same time, another ExS-TIA emerges from the darkness of night. Toka Sugawara, who attends the same school as Haruno, a.k.a ExS-TIA Luna. She too hunts for the Guilt Seeds while battling against monsters.

But what could be the ordinarily modest and quiet Toka's reasons for fighting as ExS-TIA Luna...?

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1473&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
translation:
为了另一个人，我战斗

宁静的河户东市散布着“罪恶的种子”，它们会导致人们的欲望疯狂，将他们变成危险的怪物。

为了防止如果不加以控制就会发生不可避免的灾难，板野一香委托相川春野收集这些种子。凭借新获得的ExS-Device，Haruno能够变身为ExS-TIA Ignis并寻找罪恶种子。

与此同时，另一架ExS-TIA从夜色中出现。与春野就读同一所学校的菅原十香，又名ExS-TIA Luna。她也在与怪物战斗的同时寻找罪恶种子。

但是，一向谦虚、安静的十香，以ExS-TIA Luna的身份战斗的理由是什么……？

[来自[url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1473&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
